# LMM function
```{r, standard-LMM}
# Standard function to run LMM and get publication-ready stats
run_sleep_analysis <- function(df, value_col, metric_label) {
  
  # 1. Aggregate to night level first
  dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ParticipantID, Timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    droplevels()

  # FIX: Calculate overall n for this specific metric
  total_n <- dplyr::n_distinct(dat$ParticipantID)

  # 2. Run Linear Mixed Model
  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ Timepoint + (1|ParticipantID), data = dat)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, "Timepoint")
  
  # 3. Contrasts vs Baseline
  ctr <- summary(emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1), 
                 infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "holm") %>% as.data.frame()
  
  # 4. Cohen's d
  s_val <- sigma(fit)
  edf_val <- df.residual(fit) 
  d_grid <- emmeans::eff_size(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, sigma = s_val, edf = edf_val)
  d_sum <- summary(d_grid) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(contrast, d = effect.size)
  
  # 5. Summary Stats (Mean/SD)
  stats <- dat %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mn = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 6. Clean and Combine
  ctr <- ctr %>% dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - BSL| - Baseline"))
  d_sum <- d_sum %>% dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - BSL| - Baseline"))
  
  stats %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ctr, by = "Timepoint") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(d_sum, by = "Timepoint") %>%
    # FIX: Add metric_n here so the table can see it
    dplyr::mutate(metric = metric_label, metric_n = total_n)
}
```

#  Read in spindles and SOs
```{r, read-in-files}
# --- 1. Helper Function for Timepoint Logic ---
# This avoids writing the case_when logic twice
apply_timepoint_logic <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Extract date and participant info from the filename linked during the join
      base      = basename(original_filename),
      date_str  = stringr::str_extract(base, "\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}"),
      Date      = lubridate::ymd(stringr::str_replace_all(date_str, "_", "-")),
      
      # Determine Timepoint (BSL, SRT, FU)
      tp_raw    = stringr::str_extract(base, "(?i)BSL|FU|FLW|INT|SRT_NIGHT"),
      Timepoint = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(tp_raw, "(?i)BSL") ~ "BSL",
        stringr::str_detect(tp_raw, "(?i)FU|FLW") ~ "FU",
        stringr::str_detect(tp_raw, "(?i)INT|SRT_NIGHT") ~ "SRT",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Calculate SRT Day numbers
    dplyr::group_by(ParticipantID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      first_srt    = suppressWarnings(min(Date[Timepoint == "SRT"], na.rm = TRUE)),
      DayWithinSRT = dplyr::if_else(Timepoint == "SRT", 
                                    as.integer(Date - first_srt) + 1L, NA_integer_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    # Final Labeling
    dplyr::mutate(
      Timepoint = dplyr::case_when(
        Timepoint == "SRT" & !is.na(DayWithinSRT) & DayWithinSRT <= 7 ~ paste0("Day ", DayWithinSRT),
        Timepoint == "SRT" & !is.na(DayWithinSRT) & DayWithinSRT > 7  ~ "Day 7+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(Timepoint)
      ),
      Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("BSL", paste0("Day ", 1:7), "Day 7+", "FU"))
    )
}

# --- 2. Load Blinding Key ---
blinding_key <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$blinding_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    spisop_id = as.integer(spisop_id),
    # Ensure ParticipantID is extracted for linking
    Real_ID = stringr::str_extract(basename(original_filename), "^[0-9]+")
  )

# --- 3. Process Spindles ---
spindle_raw <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$spindle_file), show_col_types = FALSE)

spindle_unblinded <- spindle_raw %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(blinding_key, by = c("datasetnum" = "spisop_id")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ParticipantID = Real_ID) %>%
  apply_timepoint_logic()

# --- 4. Process SOs ---
so_files <- list.files(here::here(params$so_dir), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

so_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(so_files, function(path) {
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(ID = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(basename(path), "\\d+")))
})

so_unblinded <- so_raw %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(blinding_key, by = c("ID" = "spisop_id")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ParticipantID = Real_ID) %>%
  apply_timepoint_logic()

# --- 5. Final Diagnostic Check ---
message("Spindle Unique Nights: ", nrow(distinct(spindle_unblinded, ParticipantID, Timepoint)))
message("SO Unique Nights: ", nrow(distinct(so_unblinded, ParticipantID, Timepoint)))
```

# Export LMM results to word table
```{r, run-lmm}

library(flextable)
library(officer)

# --- 1. Run Analysis for All 4 Metrics ---
# Spindles
res_spin_cnt  <- run_sleep_analysis(spindle_unblinded, "count", "Spindle Count")
res_spin_dens <- run_sleep_analysis(spindle_unblinded, "density_per_epoch", "Spindle Density")

# Slow Oscillations
res_so_cnt    <- run_sleep_analysis(so_unblinded, "count", "Slow Oscillation Count")
res_so_dens   <- run_sleep_analysis(so_unblinded, "density_per_epoch", "Slow Oscillation Density")

# --- 2. Combine and Format ---
# We bind them in the specific order you listed
all_metrics_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_spin_cnt, res_spin_dens, res_so_cnt, res_so_dens) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Create bold-ready headers with n
    metric_with_n = sprintf("%s (n = %d)", metric, metric_n),
    # Clean timepoint labels
    Timepoint = dplyr::recode(as.character(Timepoint), "BSL" = "Baseline", "FU" = "Follow up"),
    # Force 2 decimal places for all stats
    `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mn, sd),
    Diff_adj    = ifelse(Timepoint == "Baseline", "-", sprintf("%.2f", estimate)),
    `95% CI`    = ifelse(Timepoint == "Baseline", "-", sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL)),
    d           = ifelse(Timepoint == "Baseline", "-", sprintf("%.2f", d))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(metric_with_n, Timepoint, `Mean (SD)`, Diff_adj, `95% CI`, d)

# --- 3. Create the Styled Flextable ---
ft_master <- as_grouped_data(x = all_metrics_results, groups = "metric_with_n") %>%
  as_flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(metric_with_n = "Timepoint", Timepoint = "Timepoint") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  # Bold the grouping headers (Metric + n)
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(metric_with_n)) %>% 
  # Indent the nights under each header
  padding(i = ~ is.na(metric_with_n), j = 1, padding.left = 20) %>% 
  # Clear the data columns on the header rows
  compose(i = ~ !is.na(metric_with_n), j = 2:5, value = as_paragraph("")) %>% 
  # Professional look
  theme_booktabs() %>% 
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

# --- 4. Export to Word ---

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Summary Statistics: Spindle and Slow Oscillation Metrics", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_master)

# Specify your final output path
print(doc, target = file.path(out_dir, "SOs_spindles_LMM.docx"))

message("Master table with 4 metrics successfully saved to Word.")
```

# Generate plots
```{r plot spindles, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggprism)

# --- 1. Setup the Directory using YAML params ---
# This ensures it goes to "Figures/EEG/SOs_spindles" as requested in the YAML
final_fig_path <- here::here(params$fig_dir)

if (!dir.create(final_fig_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)) {
  # This just ensures the folder actually exists on your Mac/PC
}

# 2. Define order of timepoints
desired_levels <- c("BSL", paste0("Day ", 1:7), "FU")

# 3. Prepare Spindle Data
nights_sp_clean <- spindle_unblinded %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% desired_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = desired_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantID, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(c(count, density_per_epoch), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Spindles")

# 4. Prepare SO Data (using lowercase so_unblinded)
nights_so_clean <- so_unblinded %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% desired_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = desired_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantID, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(c(count, density_per_epoch), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Slow Oscillations")

# 5. Combine and Pivot
combined_plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(nights_sp_clean, nights_so_clean) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(count, density_per_epoch), 
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = dplyr::recode(metric, 
                           "count" = "Count", 
                           "density_per_epoch" = "Density per Epoch")
  )

# 6. Summary Stats
combined_summary <- combined_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Timepoint, metric, type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mn = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = stats::sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 7. Generate the 4-Panel Plot

p_4panel <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = combined_plot_data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = value, color = type),
             alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15)) +
  geom_line(data = combined_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = mn, color = type, group = type), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = combined_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = mn, color = type, shape = type), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = combined_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, ymin = mn - sd, ymax = mn + sd, color = type),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(metric ~ type, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Spindles" = "#2C3E50", "Slow Oscillations" = "#E74C3C")) +
theme_classic()+
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Value (Mean ± SD)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(final_fig_path, "SOs_Spindles.png"), 
  plot = p_4panel, 
  width = 14, 
  height = 10, 
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(final_fig_path, "SOs_Spindles.jpg"), 
  plot = p_4panel, 
  width = 14, 
  height = 10, 
  dpi = 300
)

p_4panel
